request.title: Approve a $240 API budget for the benchmark run?
request.why: It spends money above the owner's per-purchase approval line.
request.context: The run sends 500 sentences × 2 passes to 4 translation APIs. Estimated cost is $200–$240. A smaller run (120 sentences) costs about $60 and still shows which API is clearly worse.
request.rec_reason: The small run shows whether the comparison is worth it before spending the full amount.

response.conditions: Hard cap at $80. Stop and report if you hit $65 before finishing.

ack.note: Small run finished at $58; results are in the report. Full run not started.
